# Design contract (control plane UI)

## Primary references

1. **`docs/design-index.json`** — routes, navigation, tokens, shared blocks (sidebar, header, pills, list rows), sample data conventions.
2. **`docs/dockyrd-design.html`** — consolidated design export; per-screen `.dc.html` semantics in the index.
3. **`docs/BRIEFING.md` §9–10** — component library list (`web/components/dockyard/*`) and route → API map.

Existing artboards are the default contract. Do not invent alternate information architecture (e.g. removed "Add service" header button stays removed).

## Implementation rules

- Reuse **`web/components/dockyard/ui/*`** primitives (Storybook catalog) and **`web/components/dockyard/*`** composites before one-off page markup; extend `ui/` when a pattern repeats. See [storybook-ui-source](../../.cursor/rules/storybook-ui-source.mdc) — **stories and product import the same components**.
- Match **tokens** (colors, radii, Geist/Geist Mono roles) from design-index — implement as CSS variables in `globals.css`.
- **Accessibility:** real `<button>` / `<a>`, `aria-current="page"`, icon-only controls with `aria-label`, touch targets ≥ 44px where design specifies.
- **English UI copy** in the product (design language).

## Verification (new or changed screens)

1. **Structure:** sidebar groups, breadcrumbs, tabs, and primary CTA placement match the artboard for that route.
2. **Components:** status pills, stat tiles, resource rows use shared components — not ad-hoc duplicates.
3. **Playwright** (when `e2e/` exists): cover must-pass flows from issue rubric (login, create service, env editor, etc.).
4. **Visual regression** (optional, when harness adds it): compare key pages at **1360** and **390** against design export — report diffs; no WP/Studio baseline.

## Gaps (briefing §17)

Setup wizard, create-flows, team/instance settings, 2FA step — may use **`designer`** issue wireframes (`docs/project/issues/<id>/assets/*.html`) until merged into the main export. After implementation, update design-index notes if navigation changes.

## Not applicable

- Atelier `wireflow.html` / `design.html` section parity.
- WordPress block editor WYSIWYG gates.
